title: Jellyfish eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- jellyfish bell -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#ff7eb3'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='31' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#ffb3d1'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='26' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffe0ee' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='24' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ffe0ee' opacity='0.5'/>

  <path d='M22 38 Q28 46 34 38 Q40 46 46 38 Q52 46 58 38 Q64 46 70 38 Q76 46 78 38' fill='none' stroke='#ff4f8b' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tentacles -->
  <path d='M30 42 Q26 55 32 65 Q36 72 30 80' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec4' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 44 Q42 58 38 68 Q35 76 40 84' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec4' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 45 Q52 60 50 70 Q48 78 52 86' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec4' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='60' cy='33' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3a1a4a'/>

  <circle cx='61' cy='31' r='2' fill='#ffe0ee'/>
  <!-- mouth open -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#7a1a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff4f8b' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- snack: a little cookie/cracker going into mouth -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='7' fill='#f4c66a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#b07d2a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#b07d2a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='1.5' fill='#b07d2a'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='53' r='1' fill='#b07d2a'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='53' r='1' fill='#b07d2a'/>
  <!-- crumb bits -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#f4c66a'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='56' r='1' fill='#f4c66a'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ffb3d1' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ffb3d1' opacity='0.8'/>
